author: claude

cloud_writes.what: creates an EXTERNAL dataset QA_<run id>, a MAP history job and an S3 upload; processing is expected to fail (rotated raster)

expected: The import is accepted like any DSM, then processing fails: the DSM output is 'failed', and the History card of the dataset shows the specific, actionable message 'Rotated rasters are not supported. Re-export the raster with a north-up grid and import it again.' A generic message only ('Processing failed', 'Failed to create DSM') is a FAIL against criterion 3.

fixtures.delivery: engine: act.py deliver copies it to device_path on each tablet and to ~/qa-fixtures on W044 when it is missing and checks its sha256 there; a different file at that path is never overwritten
fixtures.name: Z11_Zurich_47.4N_1m_UTM32632_EGM96_rot5deg.tif

forbidden: the main half of the Actions split button (Process)
btn-close-modal or a tap outside the dialog

steps.read_js: (async () => { const t = localStorage.getItem('accessToken') || ''; const l = await window.Capacitor.Plugins.CapacitorHttp.get({url: 'https://api.staging.company.example/api/v1/datasets/sites/a0000001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', headers: {Authorization: 'Bearer ' + t}}); const d = (l.data || []).find(x => x.name === 'QA_{run}'); if (!d) return {found: false}; const r = await window.Capacitor.Plugins.CapacitorHttp.get({url: 'https://api.staging.company.example/api/v1/datasets/' + d.id + '/map-outputs', headers: {Authorization: 'Bearer ' + t}}); return {found: true, id: d.id, datasetStatus: (r.data || {}).datasetStatus, outputs: ((r.data || {}).outputs || []).map(o => o.type + ':' + o.status)}; })()

steps_note: Completed 2026-10-26 for test task 0000fake004 (CL-80003 criterion 3). Fixture: generated by tests/2026-10-26-terr005-rotated/tools/make_rotated.py (Zurich UTM 32N, 1 m, 256x256 Float32, rotated 5 degrees: geotransform rotation and shear 0.0872, server tolerance 1e-12). Steps as TERR-004 c8, with the folder QA-TERR-005, the failed DSM output as the processing check, and the History card as the check of the message the user sees. The Maps viewer only shows the generic 'Failed to create DSM' (MapOutputStatusIcon). c2 (2026-10-26): step 25 only taps; steps 26-27 screenshot the app and check that the import started (dialog closed), keeping the dialog text and messages. c3 (2026-10-26): steps [19, 23] (Back to close the keyboard) run only when the keyboard is on screen (visualViewport shorter than the window). c4 (2026-10-26): fixture Z11_Zurich_47.4N_1m_UTM32632_EGM96_rot5deg.tif (the same rotated DSM with the EGM96 vertical reference of the TERR-004 file, as make_rotated.py now writes it); the first Next waits for the form's default name before the name is typed; the keyboard Back steps [19, 23] are removed.

supersedes.why: the c1-c3 file had no vertical reference, which the app requires for a DSM ('3D datasets must have a vertical reference.', seen by hand on ET65 2026-10-26); the typed name raced the form's default name; the keyboard Back steps never ran
